shared.zh: 棋盘城市：只往右或往下走，每格可以有石头、体力或金币
shared.en: the grid city: right or down only, a cell may hold a rock, energy or coins

shared.zh: 棋盘城市，每格存「是 / 否」：能不能走到这里
shared.en: the grid city holding yes / no: can a route get here

shared.zh: 两堆石子：(a, b) 是两堆各剩几颗，存轮到的人能不能赢
shared.en: two piles of stones: (a, b) the stones left, holding whether the player to move wins

shared.zh: 砖块叠成的三角：从顶上一块往下走
shared.en: bricks stacked in a triangle, walked down from the top one

shared.zh: 铺草坪：一块地上有树，找最大的空正方形
shared.en: a lawn to lay: a field with trees, the biggest open square

shared.zh: 一段楼梯：一次上一级或两级，坏台阶踩不得
shared.en: a flight of stairs: one or two steps at a time, broken steps not to be stood on

shared.zh: 一堆石子：一次拿一颗或两颗，拿走最后一颗的赢
shared.en: a pile of stones: take one or two, whoever takes the last wins

shared.zh: 凑零钱：每格是一个钱数，扫描臂退回每种硬币
shared.en: making change: a cell is an amount, the sweep arm steps back by every coin

shared.zh: 切词：一串字母切成词典里的词，每块有代价
shared.en: cutting a string into dictionary words, each piece at a cost

about.zh: 一排房子，每家一个格子
about.en: a row of houses, one cell a house

shared.zh: 一排房子，每家三个格子：没偷、偷了、最多
shared.en: a row of houses, three cells a house: skipped, robbed, most so far

shared.zh: 环形的街：第一家和最后一家相邻
shared.en: a street in a ring: the first house and the last are neighbours

about.zh: 一排房子，每格是到这一家为止的总数
about.en: a row of houses, each cell the total so far

shared.zh: 一排柱子：以这一根结尾，最长连几根越来越高
shared.en: a row of posts: the longest rising run ending on this one

shared.zh: 每天的收支：以这一天结尾的一段最多赚多少
shared.en: daily gains: the best run of days ending today

shared.zh: 有钥匙和门的迷宫，状态记住的每组钥匙是一层
shared.en: a maze of keys and doors, one layer for every set of keys the state remembers

shared.zh: 过河的青蛙：每块石头写着往回能跳多远
shared.en: a frog crossing a river: each stone says how far back a jump reaches

shared.zh: 股价：每天三种状态，空手、持有、刚卖掉
shared.en: share prices: three states a day, flat, holding, just sold

shared.zh: 对齐表：一个词在上面，一个词在左边
shared.en: an alignment table: one word along the top, one down the left

shared.zh: 局部对齐：两串字最像的一段
shared.en: local alignment: the most alike stretch of two strings

shared.zh: 背包表：行是物品，列是容量
shared.en: the knapsack table: rows are items, columns capacities

about.zh: 压成一行的背包：只留一行，原地改写
about.en: the knapsack in one row, rewritten in place

shared.zh: 区间表：一段 i..j 的答案，切点扫一遍
shared.en: the interval table: the answer for a run i..j, every split point swept

shared.zh: 格子世界：宝藏、陷阱和墙，扫到不再变
shared.en: the grid world: treasure, traps and walls, scanned until it settles

shared.zh: 给句子标词性：每一列一个词，每一行一种词性
shared.en: tagging a sentence: a word a column, a part of speech a row

shared.zh: 一张图：每格的能量，找一条最不起眼的缝
shared.en: a picture: each cell’s energy, the least noticeable seam

shared.zh: 远望：视野 5×5，看得见表头，会换方向扫
shared.en: Farsight: a 5×5 view, the table’s headings, other scan orders

about.zh: 长臂：视野 5×5，伸缩臂够到任意远
about.en: Longarm: a 5×5 view, a telescopic arm

shared.zh: 千层：同时站在很多层上，探针探到另一层
shared.en: Layercake: many layers at once, a probe to another

about.zh: 回环：一轮一轮扫到不再变
about.en: Loop: scans in rounds until nothing changes
Boxy: a 3×3 view

about.zh: 扫帚：扫描臂一次扫过一整段
about.en: Broom: a sweep arm over a whole run

about.zh: 拼电路板：机器人在每一格上跑它
about.en: wiring a board the robot runs on every cell

shared.zh: 亲手填表：每个地点的路线数
shared.en: filling the table by hand: the routes to every place

shared.zh: 连线不交叉：两串字相同的字母连起来
shared.en: lines that never cross between equal letters of two strings

shared.zh: 找反例：画两条路线，落进同一个格子
shared.en: finding the counterexample: two routes into one cell

about.en: tracing every route one by one
packing a backpack by hand
drawing the arrows along the values
cutting seams out of a picture one by one

shared.zh: 一张画好的图：格子、箭头和字，坐标照写
shared.en: a picture as drawn: cells, arrows and words, at their coordinates

shared.zh: 棋盘：R 行 C 列，箭头往右往下（或按 moves），个别格子另写
shared.en: a grid of R × C with arrows right and down (or by moves), some cells written apart

shared.zh: 一小块示意电路：上面是输入，中间是元件，下面是输出
shared.en: a little circuit: inputs on top, parts in rows, outputs at the bottom

shared.zh: 机器人 3×3 的视野：每格的值，亮起的是读的格子
shared.en: the robot’s 3×3 view: what each cell holds, the ones read lit

about.zh: 输入元件上点了这个传感器
about.en: an input card reads this sensor

about.zh: 这个传感器读了，还接出了线
about.en: this sensor is read and wired on

shared.zh: 板上有这种元件（可以再说它的数值）
shared.en: the board has a part of this type (and this value)

shared.zh: 一种元件直接接进另一种元件
shared.en: a part of one type wired straight into a part of another

about.zh: 正在玩第几阶段（从 1 数）
about.en: the stage being played (from 1)
every one holds
one of them holds
this one does not hold
a part is on the board
a wire is on the board
an output is wired

shared.zh: 公共子序列表倒推出的路线和连线
shared.en: the walk back through a common-subsequence table, and its matched letters

about.zh: 编辑距离表倒推出的路线
about.en: the walk back through an edit-distance table

shared.zh: 局部对齐从最大的一格倒推到 0
shared.en: local alignment walked back from its best cell to a 0

about.en: the packing walked back through a knapsack table

shared.zh: 从最底一行最小的格子倒推的缝
shared.en: the seam walked back from the smallest cell of the bottom row

about.zh: 维特比表倒推出的词性
about.en: the tags walked back through a Viterbi table

about.zh: 通过后：表格里藏着的连线
about.en: once passed: the lines hidden in the table

shared.zh: 全部通过后：候选词按步数排
shared.en: once every test passes: the candidates by number of steps

shared.zh: 通过后：倒推出的标法（测试有 note 时加一句）
shared.en: once passed: the tagging traced back (and the test’s note)

shared.zh: 反例：一家一格时，两段历史落进同一个格子
shared.en: the counterexample: with one cell a house, two histories land in one cell

about.en: once passed: the edits traced back
once passed: the most alike stretch
once passed: the packing traced back

about.zh: 物品一览，正在改写的那件亮起
about.en: the items, the one being rewritten lit
the dictionary (and what each word costs)

shared.zh: 压成一行时，改写方向错了会把一件物品放两次
shared.en: in one row, rewriting the wrong way packs an item twice

about.zh: 读这一关的一个传感器，名字随它
about.en: a sensor of the level, named as it is

shared.zh: 第 n 条来路（a、b、c、d）：一个传感器，或板上一个只属于这一关的输入
shared.en: way in n (a, b, c, d): a sensor, or an input of the board of its own

about.en: “start”: a yes / no sensor
a port with a name of its own

shared.zh: 这款游戏教什么、学完能亲手做成什么，不写关卡数
shared.en: what the game teaches and what the player ends up building, not how many levels

about.zh: 几个元件合起来是一个新概念
about.en: parts that are one new idea together

shared.zh: 关卡解锁的元件和想法：元件箱里的名字和说明
shared.en: what levels unlock: their names and descriptions in the components box

shared.zh: 一个想法在元件箱里借用哪一关的电路板
shared.en: the level whose board an idea borrows in the components box

shared.zh: 通过它解锁的元件或想法（game.json 的 parts）
shared.en: the part or idea solving it unlocks (game.json parts)

shared.zh: 从这一关玩家留下的电路板开始（必须是先修）
shared.en: start from the board left on this level (a prerequisite)

shared.zh: 通过后电路板成为元件 unlock：它的口，和它带的一个数
shared.en: once solved the board is the part `unlock`: its ports, and a number it carries

about.zh: 一块电路板的蓝图文本，每行一个字符串
about.en: a board as blueprint text, one string a line

shared.zh: 一步步的引导：显示第一条 until 还不成立的
shared.en: step-by-step guidance: the first whose until does not hold yet

about.zh: 失败时：第一条 when 成立的说法
about.en: on a failure: the first whose when holds

shared.zh: 测试的名字：{字段}、{字段.length}、{列表|分隔符}
shared.en: a test’s name: {field}, {field.length}, {list|separator}

about.zh: 逐格判对错，不只看答案
about.en: grade every cell, not just the answer

shared.zh: 失败时不指出第一处算错的格子
shared.en: on a failure, do not point at the first cell gone wrong

about.en: the values a constant offers

shared.zh: 新元件第一次出现时只放它一个也算一关：它的用法抽象在哪里
shared.en: a new part may have a level that only places it: what is abstract about its use

shared.zh: 每个测试的正确答案，按测试的顺序（没有答案写 null）
shared.en: each test’s right answer, in the tests’ order (null where there is none)

about.zh: 接着用上一阶段的电路板
about.en: go on with the last stage’s board

shared.zh: {test}、{want}、{got} 换成失败的测试
shared.en: {test}, {want}, {got} filled in from the failed test

shared.zh: 这一阶段的失败是要讲的道理：说完进下一阶段
shared.en: failing this stage is its lesson: then on to the next
